none: PAS NCL-7DBF23: NCL-7DBF23: Roman lead sealing
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)

A military lead sealing dating to the Roman period. The sealing is rectangular in plan and section. On its upper surface is the legend 'LVI' struck on a rectangular die. On the underside of the sealing, at right angles to the upper rectangular panel, is a further rectangular die struck with the legend '.VS 7' .(...) V(...) S(...) ( ​centurio) . The location of the piercing and chord is not clear.…
